item.title: Army deems lead azide detonation a success but criticism lingers over notification
item.description: The dust may be settling after the U.S. Army detonated the nation's aging stockpile of lead azide to keep the material from spontaneously exploding, but criticism lingers over how the Army communicated its plans.

item.title: UN rapporteur Albanese in limbo at airport after being denied entry to Costa Rica
item.description: Francesca Albanese, the U.N. special rapporteur on human rights in the occupied Palestinian territories, is stranded at Costa Rica’s main airport awaiting for a court to decide whether she could enter the country after immigration authorities blocked her entry.

item.title: Norwegian budget airline Norse Atlantic files for bankruptcy after halting flights
item.description: A Norwegian budget airline has filed for bankruptcy after halting flights and ticket sales. Norse Atlantic Airways filed for bankruptcy on Friday, a day after halting flights and ticket sales.

item.title: Mexico files formal complaint to US over DEA tip line
item.description: Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum says the country is filing a formal complaint with the U.S. over a Drug Enforcement Agency tip line for anonymous reports about criminals and corrupt Mexican officials.
